g.text: "The quieter you become, the more you can hear."
"In a world of locked doors, the man with the key is king."
"There is no patch for human stupidity."
"The only truly secure system is one that is powered off."
"Security is only as strong as the weakest link."
"Think like a hacker, act like an engineer."
"First, solve the problem. Then, write the code."
"Make it work, make it right, make it fast."
"The best way to predict the future is to invent it."
"Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic."
"Programming isnt about what you know; its about what you can figure out."
"The function of good software is to make the complex appear simple."
"Premature optimization is the root of all evil."
"Its not a bug, its an undocumented feature."
"There are only two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors."
"The best error message is the one that never shows up."
"Walking on water and developing software from a specification are easy if both are frozen."
"99 little bugs in the code, take one down, patch it around, 117 little bugs in the code."
"A computer once beat me at chess, but it was no match for me at kickboxing."
"I would have written a shorter program, but I did not have the time."
"Programs must be written for people to read."
"The most damaging phrase in the language is weve always done it this way."
"Talk is cheap. Show me the code."
"If debugging is the process of removing bugs, then programming must be the process of putting them in."
"The computer was born to solve problems that did not exist before."
"Software is a gas; it expands to fill its container."
"All code is guilty until proven innocent."
"Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning."
"Never trust a computer you cant throw out a window."
"If people never did silly things, nothing intelligent would ever get done."
"It is not knowledge, but the act of learning that generates the greatest satisfaction."
"Logic is the beginning of wisdom, not the end."
"Where there is no struggle, there is no strength."
"Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet."
"Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment."
"The future depends on what you do today."
"Move fast and break things. Then fix them."
"Knowledge is power, but enthusiasm pulls the switch."
"The Internet is the first thing humanity has built that humanity doesnt understand."
"If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear a hundred battles."
"Hackers are artists, philosophers, and engineers all rolled into one."
"Every great developer you know got there by solving problems they were unqualified to solve."
"The best way to learn is to teach."
"Information is the oil of the 21st century, and analytics is the combustion engine."
"In God we trust. All others must bring data."
"Arent we all just patching the universe in real time?"
"The bug is not in your code. The bug is in your expectations."
"There is no substitute for hard work."
"The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek."
"You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough."
"Be the change you wish to see in the world."
"The only way to do great work is to love what you do."
"Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts."
"Whether you think you can, or you think you cant - youre right."
"That which does not kill us makes us stronger."
"Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value."
"Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by."
"Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny."
"Believe you can and youre halfway there."
"I have not failed. Ive just found 10,000 ways that wont work."
"A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new."
"Life is what happens when youre busy making other plans."
"Your time is limited, so dont waste it living someone elses life."
"If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else."
"Try to be a rainbow in someones cloud."
"The mind is everything. What you think you become."
"An unexamined life is not worth living."
"Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle."
"In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity."
"Whether you think you can or you think you cant, you are right."
"Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail."
"It always seems impossible until its done."
"If you can dream it, you can do it."
"Quality is not an act, it is a habit."
"The secret of getting ahead is getting started."
"The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step."
"The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today."
"Do something today that your future self will thank you for."
"Push yourself, because no one else is going to do it for you."
"Great things never come from comfort zones."
"Success doesnt just find you. You have to go out and get it."
"The harder you work for something, the greater youll feel when you achieve it."
"Success is not in what you have, but who you are."
"The key to success is to focus on goals, not obstacles."
"Believe in yourself and all that you are."
